title: Preparing Medical Imaging Data for Machine Learning

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Preparing Medical Imaging Data for Machine Learning》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence (AI) continues to garner substantial interest in medical imaging.

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) continues to garner substantial interest in medical imaging.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Preparing Medical Imaging Data for Machine Learning》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The chief obstacles to development and clinical implementation of AI algorithms include availability of sufficiently large, curated, and representative training data that includes expert labeling (eg, annotations).

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】In this article, the authors describe fundamental steps for preparing medical imaging data in AI algorithm development, explain current limitations to data curation, and explore new approaches to address the problem of data availability.

evidence.text: The chief obstacles to development and clinical implementation of AI algorithms include availability of sufficiently large, curated, and representative training data that includes expert labeling (eg, annotations).

In this article, the authors describe fundamental steps for preparing medical imaging data in AI algorithm development, explain current limitations to data curation, and explore new approaches to address the problem of data availability.
